verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents broad API coverage of core Teams actions: creating teams and channels, adding members, configuring tabs and apps, posting channel messages, and exporting chats, including deleted messages. Bots, webhooks and connectors extend this further. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and one community report notes that integrating requires the full Azure/Graph stack. Missing for 10: any documented statement of API/UI parity, evidence of API control over meetings, calling and voice features, settings and notification management, and independent corroboration of coverage breadth.
